title: TCP Receive
text: Receive data over TCP/IP network from remote host, 3 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of received data; {Connection mode} sets the block as server, {Local IP Port} sets the iP port on receiving host from which data, {Server IP Address} sets the remote IP address of server from which data is received, {Server IP Port} sets the remote IP port on server from which data, {Enable variable length} enables to receive variable data length, {Data size (N)} sets the number of data bytes in received data, {Maximum data size (N)} sets the maximum length of data, {Wait until data received} sets the wait until requested data is available and {Sample time} sets the interval at which block reads data from sending. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Requested data received at given time step scalar

params.name: Connection mode
params.values: Set the block as server or client Server (default) | Client

params.name: Local IP Port
params.values: IP port on receiving host from which data is received 25000 (default) | positive integer in the range [1,65535]

params.name: Server IP Address
params.values: Remote IP address of server from which data is received 192.168.1.10 (default) | any valid IP address

params.name: Server IP Port
params.values: Remote IP port on server from which data is received 25002 (default) | positive integer in the range [1,65535]

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of received data uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Enable variable length
params.values: Enable to receive variable data length off (default) | on

params.name: Data size (N)
params.values: Number of data bytes in received data 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum data size (N)
params.values: Maximum length of data 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Wait until data received
params.values: Wait until requested data is available on (default) | off

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Interval at which block reads data from sending host 0.1 (default) | nonnegative value
